answer: Resistance is priced in capital, not identity: staking collateral K_i binds an adversary to slashing penalty S_i, while each attestation burns fee F_n, so persona n costs F_n plus compounded opportunity cost rho K_j plus expected p S_i, and dC/dn rises because zero-knowledge verifiable delay makes forged proofs consume sequential epochs. From dune to lagoon to summit, expected utility E[U]=B-sum(F_n+rho K_j+p S_i) is negative whenever B is below the bonded-slash threshold, making honest staking the strict Nash equilibrium.
